comparison.context: Instant equals fiscal period end; durations start fiscal-year start and end report period. Validate context entity against independently authenticated issuer identity; unsupported identifier mapping is ambiguous. Only empty dimensions or exactly consolidated/separate axis shape; recorded CFS/OFS must match, and unknown basis must be independently established or remain ambiguous. No prior-period substitution.
comparison.factLocator: Locate exact recorded contextRef and element in every original XML instance. Resolve expanded namespace QName, context entity, periods, dimensions and expanded unit measure. Compare every duplicate; unresolved disagreement is ambiguous. A local-name-only nonstandard taxonomy is not sufficient proof.
comparison.independence: Use stdlib XML reader directly; no import/call/copy of dart_xbrl_statements fact parser. Only authenticated download plumbing may be reused.
comparison.number: Decimal only; compare signs and exact amounts, or equality after decimal quantization at declared decimals/precision using ROUND_HALF_EVEN. INF is exact. Positive significant precision derives decimal places from source exponent; invalid/conflicting declarations are ambiguous. Do not assume decimals is scale. Standard XBRL monetary fact scale/sign attributes are unsupported (ambiguous); inline XBRL requires a separate explicit implementation and is never silently interpreted. No float tolerance. Missing/nil/nonfinite/malformed values are ambiguous.
comparison.priority: Confirmed identity metadata mismatch; confirmed accounting/unit/context semantic mismatch; confirmed numeric mismatch; unresolved evidence. Source-unavailable is classified before parsing. A source-read exception in the validator is INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR, never an economic mismatch.
comparison.sourceIdentity: Require original filing list evidence matching ticker/stockCode, corpCode, receipt, stage and fiscal period. Compare archive and XML entry hashes. Different archive packaging alone is ambiguous unless original entry bytes are verifiably identical. No later amendment substituted.
comparison.statementEvidence: Use original package presentation linkbase roles/role definitions and concept locators. Net-income IS and CIS are semantically equivalent for the same ProfitLoss fact; record actual roles. SCE component evidence is not net-income evidence. Missing or inconclusive statement evidence is AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE_FACT, never inferred from concept name.
comparison.unit: Require source unit to expand to ISO4217:KRW and candidate currency KRW. Preserve unitRef. Divide units/unsupported currencies are semantic mismatches when source proof is conclusive.

confidence: No production enum edits. Recommend stronger fixed-sample confidence only on strict PASS; all other outcomes retain CANDIDATE_UNCONFIRMED.
descriptiveBound: Only on PASS: two-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound 1-(0.025)^(1/60); optionally label one-sided 95% bound 1-(0.05)^(1/60) separately. Descriptive, not a design-based population guarantee under balanced nonrandom deterministic sampling.

frame.unit: one stored original-XBRL record/account fact; no numeric eligibility filter

immutability: Commit protocol, sample, selector before opening source values. Later validator pins both file hashes and freeze commit; verify git ancestry and exact frozen bytes. No amendment after source inspection; no substitution or repair.
nextAfterPass: KR repaired-input snapshot freeze + accounting semantic contract; no v5 execution or final input seal in this PR.

sample.adaptation: Amounts omitted from manifest intentionally. Immutable original shard and merged shard identities bind stored amounts; candidate amounts are joined only after freeze. Statement is the candidate claimed statement, not a verified source fact. Null basis/context is retained, not excluded.
sample.algorithm: 15 rounds in net_income,operating_cash_flow,assets,liabilities order. Nonempty cells=(family,reportCode,basis,statement), smallest prior selections first, ties SHA256(canonical([seed,cell])). Within cell minimize prior global corpCode count, ties SHA256(canonical([seed,recordId+":"+family])). canonical=sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false. Never search seeds; never replace an item.

sourceAccess: Persisted raw bytes preferred. Otherwise existing DART_API_KEY environment and collect_dart_raw_statements authenticated HTTP plumbing only. Never store/print key or request URL containing key. Missing key/raw bytes -> BLOCKED_ON_SOURCE_ACCESS.
startupDeviation: Initial keyword paragraph sanitizer leaked one unrelated historical performance narrative. No result artifact or investment outcome workflow was opened/executed. No leaked information enters frame, algorithm, thresholds, comparisons or verdict. Replaced with fail-closed known-command extraction. Do not claim zero outcome exposure.

verdict.BLOCKED: no confirmed mismatch; at least one SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE_FACT
verdict.FAIL: at least one confirmed VALUE_MISMATCH, SEMANTIC_MISMATCH or METADATA_MISMATCH, irrespective of other unresolved items
verdict.INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR: process cannot produce a complete conclusive audit because of process errors; report any per-item errors explicitly. FAIL takes priority over process errors.
